caption: A magnet is moved in circles under a shallow dish of water with a paperclip floating on a piece of foam, and the clip follows the magnet around the dish.

sa.check: A shallow dish of water with a paperclip riding on a piece of foam floating on it.
A magnet is moved in circles beneath the dish.
The clip on its foam follows the magnet round the dish.
The dish is shallow, with the water surface in view.
The magnet is under the dish, not in the water.
The magnet's movement comes first and the clip follows it.

pc.expect: The foam with its clip moves only where and when the magnet below moves, staying above it, and stops when the magnet stops.
pc.fail: The clip moves in a different direction from the magnet beneath it; or keeps circling after the magnet has stopped; or stays still while the magnet passes beneath it; or the clip sets off before the magnet has begun to move.

pc.expect: The magnet stays beneath the dish's bottom, outside the water; the clip rides on top of the foam at the surface.
pc.fail: The magnet passes up through the dish bottom into the water; or the clip sinks through the foam; or the clip passes through the dish's wall; or the magnet is seen inside the water.

pc.expect: The foam floats level on the surface; the water stays in the dish with a flat surface apart from ripples.
pc.fail: The foam sinks below the surface while moving; or the water heaps up on one side of the dish while the dish is still; or the foam lifts off the water into the air.

pc.expect: The dish stays still on the table; the water moves only as ripples and eddies from the moving foam.
pc.fail: The dish slides or rotates on the table; or the water swirls as a whole before the foam moves; or other items on the table shift as the magnet passes.

pc.expect: One magnet, one clip, one piece of foam and one dish; the clip stays on its foam; nothing appears, vanishes or merges.
pc.fail: A second clip or magnet appears; or the foam vanishes leaving the clip afloat by itself; or clip and foam fuse into one object; or the dish changes shape.

pc.expect: The dish's colour, the foam's and clip's colours and the table surface stay the same.
pc.fail: The foam changes colour or size; or the clip changes shape; or the dish's pattern changes.

note: The magnet may be hidden by the dish for parts of the clip; P1 is judged on the moments when both magnet and clip are in view. The clip moving while no magnet is in view is not a violation.
